description: Save the complete content of one of the user's CVs, replacing what is there. Pass the whole CV in the shape get_takemeup_cv returns, with only the requested changes applied. Use to fill in a new CV or apply edits, rewrites and fixes. A draft with blank required fields is saved too (partial=true).

data.description: The complete normalized CV, same shape as get_takemeup_cv's `cv`.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: save_takemeup_cv
title: Save edits to my CV
